metadata.description: Incremental build plan for marathon-ralph Claude Code plugin

group.name: Minimal Viable Plugin
group.description: Create the bare minimum to load as a CC plugin with one working command. After this group: Plugin loads, /marathon-ralph:status returns "No active marathon"

task.name: Update plugin.json with complete metadata
task.details: Add: description, keywords, version following marketplace standards. Reference: chief-wiggum/.claude-plugin/plugin.json

task.name: Create marketplace.json for proper registration
task.details: Add JSON schema, owner info, plugins array with category. Reference: chief-wiggum/.claude-plugin/marketplace.json

task.name: Create status command (minimal version)
task.details: YAML frontmatter with description. Check for .claude/marathon-ralph.json If not found: "No active marathon" If found: Display basic state info Reference: plan_v3.md lines 741-782, chief-wiggum command patterns

task.name: Create README.md with basic usage
task.details: Overview, prerequisites (Linear MCP), quick start. Reference: chief-wiggum/README.md

group.test-criteria: - Plugin loads with: claude --plugin-dir ./marathon-ralph - /marathon-ralph:status returns "No active marathon" message

group.name: State Management + Setup Verification
group.description: Add setup-agent to verify Linear MCP connection and establish state file patterns. After this group: Can verify Linear is connected and create initial state file.

task.name: Create setup-agent
task.details: Model: haiku (fast checks) Tools: Read, Bash, Glob 1. Check for mcp__linear__* tools 2. Test Linear connectivity 3. Provide setup instructions if not connected 4. Create .claude/marathon-ralph.json with phase: "setup" Reference: plan_v3.md lines 123-165

task.name: Create start command (setup-only version)
task.details: YAML frontmatter with description and argument-hint for spec-file Parse --spec-file argument Run setup-agent to verify Linear Create initial state file structure Reference: plan_v3.md lines 689-739

task.name: Update status command to read real state
task.details: Read .claude/marathon-ralph.json Display phase, spec_file, linear info if available Handle all phases: setup, init, coding, complete

group.test-criteria: - /marathon-ralph:start --spec-file test.md runs setup-agent - If Linear MCP not connected, shows clear instructions - If connected, creates .claude/marathon-ralph.json with phase: "setup" - /marathon-ralph:status shows current state

group.name: Linear Project Initialization
group.description: Add init-agent to create Linear project and issues from spec file. After this group: Can read spec, create Linear project with issues.

task.name: Create init-agent
task.details: Model: opus (complex analysis) Tools: Read, Write, Edit, Glob, Grep, Bash + mcp__linear__* 1. Read spec file 2. Query Linear for teams (handle multiple) 3. Create Linear project 4. Break spec into prioritized issues (P0-P3) 5. Create META issue for tracking 6. For greenfield: discuss framework, generate init.sh, CLAUDE.md 7. Initialize git if needed 8. Update state file with Linear metadata Reference: plan_v3.md lines 169-257

task.name: Update start command to run init-agent
task.details: After setup-agent succeeds: - Run init-agent with spec file path - Update state to phase: "init" then "coding" Handle resume case (existing state with phase: "coding")

task.name: Update status command for Linear integration
task.details: Query Linear for issue counts (Done, In Progress, Todo) Show current issue being worked on Calculate progress percentage Display recent activity from META issue

group.test-criteria: - /marathon-ralph:start --spec-file spec.md creates Linear project - Issues are created with proper structure (title, description, acceptance criteria) - META issue created for tracking - State file updated with Linear IDs - /marathon-ralph:status shows accurate Linear counts

group.name: Core Coding Loop
group.description: Add verify, plan, and code agents for the main development workflow. After this group: Can pick up issues and implement features (without tests).

task.name: Create verify-agent
task.details: Model: sonnet Tools: Read, Bash, Glob, Grep 1. Detect project type from package.json/pyproject.toml 2. Run unit tests, integration tests, E2E tests 3. Run linter and type checker 4. On failure: create NEW bug issue in Linear (not reopen) 5. Return structured status report Reference: plan_v3.md lines 261-342

task.name: Create plan-agent
task.details: Model: sonnet Tools: Read, Glob, Grep 1. Read issue from Linear 2. Explore codebase for related files 3. Create step-by-step implementation plan 4. Document assumptions as Linear comment 5. Output structured plan Reference: plan_v3.md lines 346-440

task.name: Create code-agent
task.details: Model: sonnet Tools: Read, Write, Edit, Glob, Grep, Bash 1. Follow plan from plan-agent 2. Write code following CLAUDE.md conventions 3. Verify implementation manually 4. Commit with Linear issue reference Reference: plan_v3.md lines 444-515

task.name: Update start command with coding loop
task.details: After init completes (or on resume): 1. Run verify-agent 2. Query Linear for next Todo issue 3. Run plan-agent 4. Run code-agent 5. Mark issue Done in Linear 6. Update META issue with session notes Loop stops after one issue (hooks will continue)

group.test-criteria: - verify-agent detects project type and runs checks - plan-agent creates implementation plan from issue - code-agent implements feature and commits - Issue status updated in Linear - One complete issue cycle works end-to-end

group.name: Testing Agents
group.description: Add test-agent and qa-agent for comprehensive test coverage. After this group: Features get unit tests and E2E tests.

task.name: Create test-agent
task.details: Model: sonnet Tools: Read, Write, Edit, Glob, Grep, Bash 1. Review recent implementation 2. Check acceptance criteria 3. Write unit tests following existing patterns 4. Write integration tests if applicable 5. Run tests to verify passing 6. Commit test files Reference: plan_v3.md lines 519-597

task.name: Create qa-agent
task.details: Model: sonnet Tools: Read, Write, Edit, Glob, Grep, Bash 1. Check if web project (skip if not) 2. Review feature from user perspective 3. Create E2E tests (Playwright/Cypress) 4. Write tests in BDD style 5. Run and verify E2E tests 6. Commit E2E test files Reference: plan_v3.md lines 601-685

task.name: Update start command to include test agents
task.details: After code-agent completes: 1. Run test-agent 2. Run qa-agent (if web project) 3. Then mark issue Done

group.test-criteria: - test-agent writes appropriate unit tests - qa-agent creates E2E tests for web projects - qa-agent skips gracefully for non-web projects - All tests pass before issue marked Done

group.name: Continuous Operation (Stop Hook)
group.description: Add hooks for continuous autonomous operation across sessions. After this group: Marathon continues automatically until all issues Done.

task.name: Create hooks.json configuration
task.details: Configure Stop hook to run stop-hook.sh Use ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT} for path resolution Reference: plan_v3.md lines 885-902, chief-wiggum/hooks/hooks.json

task.name: Create stop-hook.sh script
task.details: 1. Read input from stdin (JSON) 2. Check for .claude/marathon-ralph.json 3. If not active or complete: allow exit 4. If active: check iteration limit (100 max) 5. Return JSON to block exit with continuation prompt 6. Include safety limits and iteration tracking Reference: plan_v3.md lines 904-966, chief-wiggum/hooks/stop-hook.sh

task.name: Make stop-hook.sh executable
task.details: chmod +x the script

group.test-criteria: - Stop hook blocks exit when marathon is active - Stop hook allows exit when marathon is complete/inactive - Iteration safety limit prevents infinite loops - Continuation prompt includes next steps

group.name: Natural Language + Cancel
group.description: Add skill for natural language invocation and cancel command. After this group: Full feature parity with plan.

task.name: Create marathon-ralph skill
task.details: YAML frontmatter with description and triggers Trigger phrases: "marathon this", "build from spec", "autonomous development" Document usage and prerequisites Map natural language to commands Reference: plan_v3.md lines 811-879

task.name: Create cancel command
task.details: 1. Check for active marathon 2. Confirm with user 3. Set active: false in state file 4. Add final note to META issue 5. Do NOT delete Linear project Reference: plan_v3.md lines 784-807

task.name: Update README.md with full documentation
task.details: Complete documentation: - All commands with examples - Skill usage examples - Architecture overview - Troubleshooting section - How hooks work

group.test-criteria: - Natural language triggers skill correctly - Cancel command stops marathon cleanly - Linear project preserved after cancel - README covers all functionality

group.name: Polish + Edge Cases
group.description: Final polish, error handling, and edge case handling. After this group: Production-ready plugin.

task.name: Add error handling to all agents
task.details: Handle: Linear API failures, missing files, git conflicts Provide clear error messages Graceful degradation where possible

task.name: Add CLAUDE.md for plugin development
task.details: Developer documentation for contributing Plugin architecture overview Testing instructions

task.name: Create sample spec file for testing
task.details: Reference: plan_v3.md lines 1072-1115 Todo app example with all sections

task.name: Add assets/banner.png
task.details: Visual asset for marketplace listing

group.test-criteria: - All error cases handled gracefully - Sample spec works end-to-end - Documentation complete - Ready for marketplace submission

dependencies.note: Groups must be completed in order (1 → 2 → 3 → ... → 8). Each group depends on the previous group being complete. Within a group, tasks can often be done in parallel.

success-criteria.criterion: Issues are dynamically generated based on spec content
Team selection works when user has multiple Linear teams
Verification runs before each new issue
Regressions create new linked bug issues (not reopen)
Each agent completes its designated task
Stop hook continues marathon until all issues Done
Natural language invocation works via skill
Greenfield projects get init.sh and CLAUDE.md
Git commits reference Linear issue IDs
META issue tracks session handoff notes
